thread: eli-docs: starting a small PR to document an offline keystore rotation flow for private deployments (Java truststores, PKCS12, k8s secret swap, and sealed-site notes). PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2102 sana-engr: awesome. customers keep failing when rotating because they forget to update both the agent keystore and the JVM truststore. can we have a step-by-step with commands for converting PEM -> PKCS12 and keytool examples? eli-docs: yes. planning to add step list + minimal scripts. draft snippets: ```bash # convert PEM (cert+key) to PKCS12 openssl pkcs12 -export -out redwood-keystore.p12 -inkey priv.key -in cert.pem -certfile chain.pem -passout pass:ChangeMe # import into java keystore keytool -importkeystore -srckeystore redwood-keystore.p12 -srcstoretype pkcs12 -srcstorepass ChangeMe -destkeystore redwood.jks -deststorepass ChangeMe ``` oliver-sre: add a reminder to check key aliases. some runtimes expect `server` alias; others expect the first entry. include `keytool -list -keystore redwood.jks -storepass ChangeMe` example. also note permission bits for keystore files (600) and system account ownership. eli-docs: added alias note and perms. for k8s private deploys i'll show how to create a secret and do a zero-downtime rollout: ```bash kubectl create secret generic redwood-keystore --from-file=redwood.jks -n redwood --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f - # then rollout restart the Deployment that mounts it kubectl rollout restart deployment/redwood-agent -n redwood ``` sana-engr: for sealed / airgapped sites, add the offline bundle steps: where to place the PKCS12, how to import into the local keystore, and a note about not checking keystore passwords into the bundle. include a sample `bundle/README` with steps and GPG signature verification. eli-docs: good call. will add `examples/keystore/rotate.sh` and a `bundle/README.md` with `gpg --verify` + `sha512sum` checks. also including a one-liner for automating idempotent imports on edge nodes. oliver-sre: also include a small ordering advisory for services: 1) import new keystore, 2) confirm service can read keystore, 3) restart agent, 4) restart dependent JVM services. if you reverse steps you'll get TLS handshake failures and stale connections. add a troubleshooting bullet for `TLS handshake failed` -> `keystore alias mismatch or wrong password` -> `verify alias + try keytool -v -list`. eli-docs: adding troubleshooting table. sample check commands: ```bash # dump cert chain from keystore keytool -list -v -keystore redwood.jks -storepass ChangeMe | sed -n '/Alias name/,/Owner/p' # verify PKCS12 contents openssl pkcs12 -in redwood-keystore.p12 -nodes -passin pass:ChangeMe -nokeys -info ``` ci-bot: docs linkcheck warning: cross-link to docs/private/install#keystore-rotation is missing anchor on PR #2102. eli-docs: thanks CI. I'll add explicit anchors (``) to the markdown and update references. sana-engr: add vendor HSM caveat: when using PKCS11-backed keystores, the JVM often needs `-Djavax.net.ssl.keyStoreType=PKCS11` and a config file pointing to the PKCS11 module. include an example `pkcs11.cfg` and `java` opts. eli-docs: adding PKCS11 example and a fallback flow: if PKCS11 module unavailable, fall back to a mounted PKCS12 with a short TTL and alert. also documenting how to rotate secrets in orchestration: k8s secret -> sealed secret -> airgap-import -> apply. oliver-sre: include a short healthcheck curl example to validate post-rotation: `curl --cacert /etc/redwood/ca.pem https://localhost:8443/health` and a note about checking `openssl s_client -connect :8443 -showcerts` if curl fails. mention clock skew as a common root cause for cert validation issues. eli-docs: added healthcheck snippet and clock-skew note. also adding `systemctl` restart order for systemd installs: `systemctl stop redwood-agent && systemctl restart redwood-app` pattern with explanation. ci-bot: lint: please wrap long lines in the keytool examples. eli-docs: wrapped and pushed. tagging @sana-engr + @oliver-sre for quick review. once linkcheck is green i'll merge and upload example scripts to `examples/keystore/` in the repo. thanks! :lock: :package:
